title: Sheep wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='wool' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#dfe6f0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- fluffy wool body made of overlapping circles -->
  <g fill='url(#wool)' stroke='#c3cddd' stroke-width='1.2'>
    <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='20'/>
    <circle cx='30' cy='52' r='13'/>
    <circle cx='70' cy='52' r='13'/>
    <circle cx='36' cy='68' r='12'/>
    <circle cx='64' cy='68' r='12'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='12'/>
    <circle cx='24' cy='62' r='10'/>
    <circle cx='76' cy='62' r='10'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='72' r='11'/>
  </g>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='38' y='76' width='6' height='16' rx='3' fill='#8a96ad'/>
  <rect x='56' y='76' width='6' height='16' rx='3' fill='#8a96ad'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='37' y='88' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#4a5570'/>
  <rect x='55' y='88' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#4a5570'/>
  <!-- face -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='47' rx='12' ry='11' fill='#f7d9b8'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='40' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#e8b98f' transform='rotate(-20 35 40)'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='40' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#e8b98f' transform='rotate(20 65 40)'/>
  <!-- sunglasses -->
  <g>
    <rect x='34' y='42' width='13' height='9' rx='4' fill='#2d2a4a' stroke='#5a6fa8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <rect x='53' y='42' width='13' height='9' rx='4' fill='#2d2a4a' stroke='#5a6fa8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <rect x='46' y='45' width='8' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#5a6fa8'/>
    <rect x='30' y='44' width='5' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#5a6fa8'/>
    <rect x='65' y='44' width='5' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#5a6fa8'/>
  </g>
  <!-- shine on lenses -->
  <line x1='37' y1='44' x2='41' y2='44' stroke='#8fa4d8' stroke-width='1.4'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='44' x2='60' y2='44' stroke='#8fa4d8' stroke-width='1.4'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='2.5' ry='1.8' fill='#c98a94'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M46 57 Q50 60 54 57' fill='none' stroke='#b0717e' stroke-width='1.3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='55' r='2.5' fill='#f2a3ac' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='55' r='2.5' fill='#f2a3ac' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
